phrases.text: You found Pirate Shop Access? Don't waste it. Here's exactly what to do.
Open the Item Shop and look for the Plunder the Item Shop option.
Hit Activate Now, and your 14 days start right there.
You actually get two: one for this year, and one you can save for 2027.
And you have to claim each item yourself. Nothing lands automatically!
Which skin would you claim first?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
